primary_finding: 流股4（A+C 混合进料）上游供给压力损失：异常起始（第 161 样本）XMEAS_4 进料流量瞬态跌落 -12.29σ，控制器将 XMV_4 进料阀开大 +25.13%（瞬态 +18.73σ 后稳态保持 +12.24σ）使进料流量完全恢复（稳态偏移 -0.25σ），反应器压力瞬态波动后重新受控，其余进料与全部被控量稳态归零——补偿成功的供给侧扰动指纹完整。判为 DETERMINED@0.82：机理（流股4 供给压力损失，含 C header）已确证；上游 header 的具体物理成因需上游压力测点方可进一步归因。

process_fluctuation_analysis.grouping_basis: no product group column; single-product analysis
process_fluctuation_analysis.time_order_basis: parsed timestamp axis (3-min sampling, 960 rows, monotonic) — real time

key_process_findings.finding: onset transient dip -12.29σ then full recovery to held offset -0.25σ — supply interruption then compensation
valve stepped +25.13% (transient +18.73σ, held +12.24σ) and stayed open — compensation action
reactor pressure transient -27.57/37.85σ, re-controlled to 0.01σ held offset
stripper steam flow variance ratio 35 with small mean shift — secondary perturbation, no held offset
all other feeds: transient excursions but held offsets within ±0.25σ — production maintained

ontology_physics_reasoning.governing_law: valve flow equation: opening ↑ under fixed downstream demand ⇒ upstream supply pressure ↓
ontology_physics_reasoning.reasoning_summary: 阀门开大 +25% 且流量恢复恒定：唯一自洽解释是阀上游供给压力下降

ontology_physics_reasoning.governing_law: 质量/动量守恒：供给中断 → 流量瞬跌 → 补偿恢复
ontology_physics_reasoning.reasoning_summary: 跌落-恢复-保持三段结构与供给中断+补偿一致

ontology_physics_reasoning.governing_law: 进料中断 → 反应器压力瞬态扰动 → 控制回路重新受控
ontology_physics_reasoning.reasoning_summary: 瞬态大幅波动后稳态归零，属受扰后果而非独立根源

process_fluctuation_analysis.conclusion: 扰动根源在流股4 供给侧（header 压力损失），XMV_4 补偿成功使生产维持；反应器侧波动为后果
